description: This file defines the 'aCase' class, representing a support case in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for case attributes, methods for managing relationships, retrieving related data, and generating view data, typical for an ORM-like model class.

classes.name: aCase
classes.description: Represents a support case in SuiteCRM with properties for case details and methods for relationship management, view rendering, and data retrieval.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the case's name as its summary text.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control logic for listing view, determining user permissions related to the associated account.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves changes to relationships, specifically establishing contact relationships if specified.

methods.name: set_case_contact_relationship
methods.description: Links a contact to this case with a default role.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates supplementary fields like assigned user names and related account info.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves related contacts for the case, returning a list with contact details and roles.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Generates data for list views, including formatted status, priority, and action icons.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause for searching cases by name, account name, or case number.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Prepares the email notification content with case details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether this bean supports certain interfaces like ACL.

methods.name: getEmailSubjectMacro
methods.description: Retrieves the macro used for email subject parsing in inbound emails.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Fetches associated account details for a given case.
